title: Where Does It Hurt: Human Anatomy & Pain Verbs (өвдөх, хатгах, чинэрэх)
primaryPurpose: Introduce human anatomical vocabulary (толгой, хоолой, гэдэс, нуруу, шүд, үе мөч) paired with sensory pain descriptors (өвдөх, хатгах, шархирах, янгинах, чинэрэх).
communicativeOutcome: Pinpoint physical pain and differentiate between sharp, throbbing, aching, and stabbing sensations.
readingObjective: Read an anatomical clinic poster diagramming internal organs and pain zones.
listeningObjective: Understand a patient describing a localized headache vs sinus pressure.
writingObjective: List 6 human body parts and pair each with a specific discomfort verb.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain symptoms to a doctor: 'Миний хоолой сөөж, толгой янгинаж өвдөж байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Using precise Mongolian sensory verbs to convey the specific nature of internal pain.
reviewReason: Expands basic physical condition adjectives into nuanced somatic sensory descriptions.
audioPurpose: Pronounce anatomical body parts and sensory pain verbs clearly.
successCriteria: Identifies anatomical areas: нуруу (back), үе мөч (joints), хоолой (throat), гэдэс (stomach)
Differentiates хатгах (sharp/stabbing) from янгинах (aching/throbbing)
masteryEvidence: Accurately describes 4 distinct pain scenarios matching body part to specific sensation.

title: Deciphering Clinic Intake Forms & Triage Questionnaires
primaryPurpose: Develop reading comprehension for clinic intake forms (үзлэгийн хуудас), pain scale questionnaires (1-10 оноо), and symptom checklists.
communicativeOutcome: Inspect medical intake paperwork, identify chronic vs acute complaints, and rate pain severity.
readingObjective: Extract pain onset date, severity rating, and anatomical checkboxes from a clinic intake sheet.
writingObjective: Transcribe personal allergy history and symptoms onto a medical template.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain to a triage nurse where the pain is centered based on questionnaire answers.
pragmaticTarget: Providing clear, concise medical self-assessments on formal paperwork.
reviewReason: Recycles calendar date reading for establishing medical symptom onset.
audioPurpose: Read clinical intake form categories aloud.
successCriteria: Locates sections for current symptoms (одоогийн зовиур) and past illnesses (өнгөрсөн өвчин)
Understands medical pain scale rankings from 1 (хөнгөн) to 10 (тэсвэрлэшгүй)
masteryEvidence: Fills in complete clinic registration card based on a simulated somatic profile.

title: Acoustic Lab: Triage Nurse Assessments & Blood Pressure Checks
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of nurse triage checks: measuring blood pressure (даралт үзэх), checking temperature (халуун хэмжих), and asking diagnostic questions.
communicativeOutcome: Understand nurse instructions during preliminary triage and extract vital sign values (blood pressure and body temperature).
listeningObjective: Extract blood pressure reading ('120-той 80') and temperature ('38.2 градус') from spoken nurse dialogue.
spokenProductionObjective: Ask nurse if the readings are normal: 'Миний даралт хэвийн байна уу?'.
pragmaticTarget: Following physical clinical instructions promptly (rolling up sleeves, breathing deeply).
reviewReason: Applies polite imperative listening (-аарай) to clinical examination instructions.
audioPurpose: Deliver realistic nurse-patient triage dialogue with blood pressure cuff velcro sounds.
successCriteria: Transcribes vital sign numbers accurately from auditory speech stream
Understands whether the nurse reports elevated blood pressure (өндөр даралт) or fever (халуунтай)
masteryEvidence: Accurately notes down vital metrics for 3 distinct triage audio vignettes.

title: In the Examination Room: Explaining Pain to the General Practitioner
primaryPurpose: Master spoken interaction with a physician: answering palpation questions ('Энд дарахад өвдөж байна уу?'), detailing duration, and explaining when pain worsens.
communicativeOutcome: Conduct a clinical consultation with a doctor, specifying pain location, intensity, and aggravating factors (eating, moving, cold).
listeningObjective: Understand doctor's diagnostic questions during physical examination.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe pain: 'Баруун хавирган дор хатгаж өвдөөд, гүнзгий амьсгалахад улам хүчтэй болж байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Responding accurately to diagnostic palpation without minimizing symptoms.
reviewReason: Recycles witnessed past tense (-лаа4) to report when symptoms started.
audioPurpose: Model gentle, inquisitive doctor voice and clear patient symptom articulation.
successCriteria: Explains pain location and triggers clearly during physical examination
Follows doctor's commands: 'Гүнзгий амьсгал аваад гаргаарай', 'Хэлээ гаргаарай'
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn simulated doctor-patient examination dialogue without communicative breakdown.

title: When I Walk, It Hurts: The Temporal Converb (-хад/-хэд/-ход/-хөд)
primaryPurpose: Introduce the temporal-locative converb (-хад4 / -хэд / -ход / -хөд) indicating 'when/while/upon doing', essential for describing conditions under which symptoms manifest.
communicativeOutcome: Explain conditional symptoms: 'Явахад хөл өвдөж байна' (When walking, my leg hurts), 'Ханиалгахад цээж хатгаж байна' (When coughing, my chest stabs).
readingObjective: Read medical advisory articles explaining when patients should seek urgent care.
listeningObjective: Identify the temporal suffix (-хад4) in patients' symptom descriptions.
writingObjective: Combine 3 verbal actions with symptom predicates using the temporal converb.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain symptom triggers: 'Юм залгихад хоолой маш хүчтэй өвдөж байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Connecting physical actions directly to symptom triggers in clear temporal-locative clauses.
reviewReason: Expands dative-locative case marking (-д/-т) from nouns to nominalized verbs (-х + -д = -хад).
audioPurpose: Model quadruple vowel harmony in temporal suffix (-хад, -хэд, -ход, -хөд).
successCriteria: Applies correct temporal allomorph according to root vowel harmony
Constructs well-formed complex sentence connecting action trigger to somatic reaction
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Босоход толгой эргэж байна' with accurate pronunciation and morphology.

title: Cold, Flu & Fatigue: Systemic Illness Vocabulary
primaryPurpose: Introduce systemic illness and constitutional symptom vocabulary (ханиад томуу, халуурах, даарах, жихүүцэх, дотор муухайрах, толгой эргэх, сульдах).
communicativeOutcome: Describe common winter ailments, viral symptoms, nausea, dizziness, and bodily chills.
readingObjective: Read a public health bulletin outlining influenza precautions and warning signs.
listeningObjective: Understand colleague calling in sick explaining flu symptoms.
writingObjective: List 5 winter illness symptoms in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain feeling unwell: 'Би өчигдрөөс хойш жихүүцэж, халуураад, бие маш их сульдаж байна'.
registerTarget: Everyday health condition and workplace absence register
pragmaticTarget: Accurately conveying systemic malaise without understating severity.
reviewReason: Connects cold climatic conditions with seasonal respiratory illnesses.
audioPurpose: Pronounce systemic symptom terms clearly.
successCriteria: Identifies systemic symptoms: жихүүцэх (chills), халуурах (fever), дотор муухайрах (nausea), толгой эргэх (dizziness)
Forms compound symptom statements: 'Халуурахад жихүүцдэг'
masteryEvidence: Accurately categorizes 6 common cold/flu symptoms and explains their physical sensations.

title: Calling In Sick: Requesting Leave & Explaining Flu Symptoms
primaryPurpose: Develop spoken communicative fluency for calling a supervisor or teacher, explaining acute illness, requesting sick leave (чөлөө авах), and promising a medical certificate.
communicativeOutcome: Call your office or school to report illness, state expected absence duration, and confirm coverage for urgent tasks.
listeningObjective: Understand manager expressing sympathy and asking about doctor consultation.
spokenProductionObjective: Call supervisor: 'Багш аа / захирал аа, миний бие өвдөөд, өнөөдөр хичээлдээ/ажилдаа ирж чадахгүй нь. Эмчид үзүүлээд бичиг авчиръя'.
pragmaticTarget: Apologizing politely for unexpected absence and confirming medical note protocol.
reviewReason: Applies professional phone courtesy to medical emergency notifications.
audioPurpose: Deliver authentic congested/sick phone voice contrasting with understanding manager.
successCriteria: Articulates illness reason clearly and requests specific days of leave
Promises to bring formal doctor note (эмчийн магадлагаа)
masteryEvidence: Completes 4-turn sick leave telephone call without communicative hesitation.

title: Calling In Sick: Workplace Absence Notice & Urgent Shift Handover
primaryPurpose: Execute an urgent telephone dialogue with a department supervisor to report acute illness and request absence.
communicativeOutcome: Extract key public health advisories regarding high-risk groups, clinic operating hours, and fever management recommendations from radio broadcasts.
listeningObjective: Identify recommended home care steps (warm fluids, rest) and when to visit hospital from public service audio.
spokenProductionObjective: State inability to work politely: 'Миний халуураад, өнөөдөр ажилдаа ирж чадахгүй нь. Эмчийн магадалгаа авчиръя'.
pragmaticTarget: Parsing professional broadcast Mongolian with medical terminology.
reviewReason: Expands broadcast listening competence from traffic alerts to health announcements.
audioPurpose: Authoritative radio broadcaster tone with official public health advisory background chime.
successCriteria: Identifies fever threshold (38.5°C) requiring doctor consultation from broadcast
Extracts district clinic extended weekend hours from announcement
masteryEvidence: Fills in public health guideline summary table with 100% accuracy based on broadcast.

title: Formal Absence: Writing a Sick Leave Note & Symptom Report
primaryPurpose: Synthesize temporal converbs (-хад4), symptom vocabulary, and polite written formulas into a formal written sick leave request (чөлөө гуйх өргөдөл / мэдэгдэл).
communicativeOutcome: Draft a formal written absence notification to an employer or university stating symptom onset, medical appointment, and expected return date.
readingObjective: Review a model Mongolian workplace absence email to observe formal salutation and sign-off.
writingObjective: Draft a 5-sentence formal absence memo using the temporal converb (-хад4) and formal medical terms.
pragmaticTarget: Adhering to standard Mongolian corporate and academic absence request conventions.
reviewReason: Elevates written delay notices to formal sick leave documentation.
audioPurpose: Audio read-back of formal sick leave document.
successCriteria: Produces formal written memo with correct heading, date, and respectful closing
Includes at least one temporal converb clause: 'Эмнэлэгт үзүүлэхэд эмч 3 өдрийн амралт өгсөн тул...'
masteryEvidence: Drafts complete, error-free workplace sick leave email with accompanying doctor note reference.

title: At the Pharmacy: Dosages, Pills, Syrups & Prescriptions
primaryPurpose: Introduce pharmacy and pharmaceutical vocabulary (эмийн сан, эмчийн жор, шахмал эм, сироп, түрхлэг, тун хэмжээ, хоолны дараа/өмнө).
communicativeOutcome: Ask for over-the-counter medicine, understand pharmacist dosage instructions, and check prescription requirements.
readingObjective: Read pharmacy counter signs identifying prescription-only (жороор олгох) vs OTC medications.
listeningObjective: Understand pharmacist explaining whether to take medicine before or after meals.
writingObjective: List 4 types of medical preparations (шахмал, сироп, дусаалга, тос) in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Ask a pharmacist: 'Хоолойн өвчинд уух сайн эм юу байна вэ?'.
pragmaticTarget: Clarifying timing relative to food intake (хоолноос өмнө / дараа) for optimal pharmaceutical efficacy.
reviewReason: Expands retail shopping into pharmaceutical terminology and health regimens.
audioPurpose: Pronounce pharmaceutical dosage forms clearly.
successCriteria: Distinguishes шахмал (tablets), сироп (syrup), түрхлэг (ointment), дусаалга (drops)
Understands timing: хоолны өмнө (before meals) vs хоолны дараа (after meals)
masteryEvidence: Accurately interprets 4 distinct pharmaceutical dosage regimens.

title: Deciphering Medicine Boxes & Patient Information Leaflets
primaryPurpose: Develop targeted reading comprehension of Mongolian pharmaceutical packaging (хайрцаг), expiry dates (дуусах хугацаа), storage conditions, and contraindications.
communicativeOutcome: Inspect a medicine box to locate daily dosage limits, storage temperature (хөргөгчинд хадгалах), and expiry date.
readingObjective: Extract maximum daily dose (өдөрт хамгийн ихдээ 3 ширхэг), expiry month/year, and cautionary warnings from a medicine box.
writingObjective: Transcribe medication dosage instructions onto an adhesive bottle label in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain package warning to a family member: 'Энэ эмийг хүүхдээс хол хадгалах ёстой'.
registerTarget: Technical medical packaging and advisory register
pragmaticTarget: Checking expiry dates and child-safety storage warnings vigilantly.
reviewReason: Applies calendar date decoding to medicine manufacturing and expiry stamps.
audioPurpose: Read package warning statements aloud.
successCriteria: Locates expiry date and batch number accurately on box
Extracts daily pill intake ceiling without error
masteryEvidence: Answers 4 comprehension questions based on an authentic Mongolian medicine box label.

title: Acoustic Lab: Pharmacist Consultation & Side Effect Cautions
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of fast pharmacist explanations behind security glass: side effects (нойр хүргэх, толгой өвдөх), drug interactions, and water intake.
communicativeOutcome: Extract crucial warnings from pharmacist audio: whether the drug causes drowsiness, if it should be taken with milk or water, and duration of course.
listeningObjective: Identify specific cautionary advice ('Энэ эмийг уугаад машин барьж болохгүй, нойр их хүргэнэ') from pharmacist audio.
spokenProductionObjective: Warn a companion not to drive after taking the prescribed cold remedy.
pragmaticTarget: Heeding contraindication warnings (avoiding alcohol, not operating machinery).
reviewReason: Applies polite imperative listening to health safety warnings.
audioPurpose: Authentic pharmacy counter dialogue with pill bottle rattle and clear protective guidance.
successCriteria: Identifies whether medicine induces drowsiness from audio stream
Extracts daily dosage frequency (өдөрт гурван удаа, нэг нэгээр)
masteryEvidence: Correctly notes down dosage and side-effect profile for 3 audio pharmacist consultations.

title: At the Drugstore Counter: Buying Remedies & Asking for Generics
primaryPurpose: Master spoken interaction at a pharmacy counter: presenting a prescription, asking for affordable generic alternatives, asking for fever reducers, and clarifying instructions.
communicativeOutcome: Purchase needed medications at a Mongolian drugstore, ask for an equivalent domestic generic, and verify dosage schedule.
listeningObjective: Understand pharmacist verifying identity and explaining domestic equivalent brand.
spokenProductionObjective: Conduct transaction: 'Энэ жорын дагуу эмүүдийг авъя. Үнэтэй импортын эмний оронд ижил найрлагатай монгол эм байна уу?'.
pragmaticTarget: Inquiring about generic equivalents (ижил найрлагатай эм) professionally and cost-effectively.
reviewReason: Transforms general store buying routines into specialized pharmacy transactions.
audioPurpose: Provide realistic dialogue between customer seeking cold relief and helpful pharmacist.
successCriteria: Conducts a complete purchase of 2 medications specifying symptoms or prescription
Verifies and repeats back dosage regimen accurately
masteryEvidence: Completes a 5-turn pharmacy roleplay with zero misunderstandings.

title: Need to & Must: Modal Obligation with Хэрэгтэй & Ёстой
primaryPurpose: Introduce the modal constructions of obligation: verbal noun in -х + хэрэгтэй (need to / advisory necessity) and verbal noun in -х + ёстой (must / moral or institutional duty).
communicativeOutcome: Differentiate between personal necessity ('Би эрт унтах хэрэгтэй') and binding rule/obligation ('Иргэн бүр татвар төлөх ёстой').
readingObjective: Read clinic discharge instructions outlining necessary recovery regimens.
listeningObjective: Identify modal markers (хэрэгтэй vs ёстой) in doctor's advice and clinic regulations.
writingObjective: Transform 4 basic verbal sentences into advisory and binding obligation statements.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain obligations: 'Та энэ эмийг долоо хоног тасралтгүй уух ёстой'.
pragmaticTarget: Distinguishing soft personal recommendations (хэрэгтэй) from non-negotiable rules (ёстой).
reviewReason: Transforms habitual verbs into modalized obligation statements.
audioPurpose: Model prosodic prominence on modal predicators (хэрэгтэй, ёстой).
successCriteria: Combines verbal noun in -х with хэрэгтэй for advisory recommendations
Combines verbal noun in -х with ёстой for mandatory statutory/medical requirements
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Би эмчид үзүүлэх хэрэгтэй, харин та маск зүүх ёстой' with accurate semantic contrast.

title: Doctor's Orders: Post-Op Care & Mandatory Health Regimens
primaryPurpose: Master spoken interaction discussing mandatory treatment protocols: dietary restrictions, follow-up tests, physical therapy, and medication compliance.
communicativeOutcome: Consult with a physician regarding post-treatment care, clarify mandatory follow-up appointments, and negotiate work restrictions.
listeningObjective: Understand doctor explaining mandatory restrictions: 'Та хоёр долоо хоног хүнд юм өргөж болохгүй, заавал давтан шинжилгээ өгөх ёстой'.
spokenProductionObjective: Ask doctor: 'Би хэзээ ажилдаа орж болох вэ? Хоолонд ямар дэглэм барих ёстой вэ?'.
pragmaticTarget: Clarifying clinical restrictions thoroughly to avoid complications.
reviewReason: Spirals past-tense surgery reports into future modal obligations.
audioPurpose: Clear, firm doctor guidance and attentive patient verification questions.
successCriteria: Identifies which health regimens are compulsory (ёстой) vs optional (хэрэгтэй)
Asks clarifying questions regarding duration of physical restrictions
masteryEvidence: Executes 5-turn medical follow-up consultation clarifying all dietary and physical restrictions.

title: Hospital Rules & Recovery: Patient Regimens & Protocols
primaryPurpose: Introduce institutional hospital rules and medical recovery vocabulary (дэглэм сахих, гам барих, тайван байх, цээрлэх, хориглох, баримтлах).
communicativeOutcome: Explain hospital visiting hours, quarantine rules, and post-illness recovery regimens (гам барих).
readingObjective: Read inpatient ward guidelines specifying quiet hours and hygiene protocols.
listeningObjective: Understand head nurse briefing visitors on sanitation and shoe-cover requirements.
writingObjective: List 5 essential post-operative recovery rules in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain recovery advice: 'Ханиад хүрсний дараа дор хаяж гурав хоног сайн гам барих хэрэгтэй'.
pragmaticTarget: Appreciating traditional Mongolian post-illness recuperation concepts (гам барих).
reviewReason: Links polite request forms to institutional obligation structures.
audioPurpose: Pronounce clinical protocol terms clearly.
successCriteria: Defines дэглэм сахих (follow a regimen), гам барих (post-illness recuperation), цээрлэх (abstain from)
Forms obligations using ёстой for mandatory ward rules
masteryEvidence: Accurately maps 6 hospital rules into mandatory (ёстой) vs recommended (хэрэгтэй) categories.

title: Acoustic Lab: Inpatient Ward Announcements & Discharge Briefings
primaryPurpose: Develop acoustic listening comprehension of hospital ward public address announcements, meal schedules, doctor rounds, and discharge briefings.
communicativeOutcome: Extract mandatory hospital ward schedules (inspection rounds, visiting hour ends, mandatory medicine administration) from loudspeaker audio.
listeningObjective: Identify specific times for doctor rounds ('Эмчийн үзлэг өглөө 9 цагт эхэлнэ') and visitor departure from ward audio.
spokenProductionObjective: Inform a hospital visitor that visiting hours are ending in 15 minutes.
pragmaticTarget: Parsing announcements over ambient corridor footsteps and cart acoustics.
reviewReason: Expands public institutional listening from banks to healthcare facilities.
audioPurpose: Hospital hallway reverberation with gentle, authoritative nurse announcements.
successCriteria: Extracts visiting hour restrictions accurately from acoustic broadcast
Understands patient preparation requirements prior to diagnostic rounds
masteryEvidence: Accurately completes hospital ward schedule log based on 3 audio announcements.

title: Care Protocol: Writing a Patient Discharge Plan & Daily Regimen
primaryPurpose: Synthesize modal obligation structures (хэрэгтэй, ёстой), medical recovery vocabulary, and sequential steps into a written home care plan.
communicativeOutcome: Draft a written 5-step home recovery schedule for a recovering family member, detailing medication timing, dietary limits, and rest.
readingObjective: Review a sample clinic discharge summary to observe professional layout.
writingObjective: Draft a 5-point home care regimen using both хэрэгтэй and ёстой accurately.
pragmaticTarget: Formatting clear, unambiguous instructions for family caretakers.
reviewReason: Connects sequential converb timelines (-аад) with modal obligation milestones.
audioPurpose: Audio read-back of written patient recovery plan.
successCriteria: Produces written care plan using both хэрэгтэй (advisory) and ёстой (mandatory)
Includes precise temporal intervals: өдөрт 3 удаа, 7 хоногийн турш
masteryEvidence: Drafts 'Өглөө бүр эмийг хоолны дараа уух ёстой. Мөн өдөрт 2 литр ус уух хэрэгтэй...' flawlessly.

title: Allowed & Forbidden: Modal Permission with Болно & Болохгүй
primaryPurpose: Introduce modal structures of permission and prohibition: converb in -ж/-ч + болно (may / allowed to do) and -ж/-ч + болохгүй (must not / forbidden).
communicativeOutcome: Ask for permission ('Би энд сууж болох уу?'), grant permission ('Борно оо'), and state prohibitions ('Энд тамхи татаж болохгүй').
readingObjective: Read public civic signs prohibiting smoking, photography, or parking.
listeningObjective: Recognize permission requests ('-ж болох уу?') and affirmative/negative grants.
writingObjective: Write 4 sentences contrasting permitted actions with prohibited actions in public buildings.
spokenProductionObjective: Request permission politely: 'Уучлаарай, би энэ утсаар ярьж болох уу?'.
pragmaticTarget: Asking for permission smoothly in social settings to demonstrate good manners.
reviewReason: Combines coordinating converb stem (-ж/-ч) with modal verb болох.
audioPurpose: Model polite rising intonation in permission queries ('-ж болох уу?').
successCriteria: Attaches coordinating converb (-ж/-ч) to verbal root before болно/болохгүй
Formulates polite permission inquiries using polar particle: '-ж болох уу?'
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Энд зураг авч болохгүй, харин гар утсаа ашиглаж болно' accurately.

title: Reading Condominium Association (СӨХ) Charter Rules & Pet Regulations
primaryPurpose: Analyze official residential bylaws regarding pet keeping, common area maintenance, and parking rules.
communicativeOutcome: Understand apartment building regulations regarding evening quiet hours (22:00 цагаас хойш дуу чимээ гаргаж болохгүй), pet rules, and trash disposal.
readingObjective: Read an entrance foyer bulletin board posting of building association (СӨХ) bylaws.
listeningObjective: Understand building manager explaining renovation noise hours to a new resident.
writingObjective: List 4 prohibited actions in residential apartment hallways in Cyrillic.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain building rules to a neighbor: 'Амралтын өдрүүдэд өрөм тавьж засвар хийж болохгүй'.
registerTarget: Neighborhood association and community residential register
pragmaticTarget: Maintaining neighborly harmony through strict adherence to communal quiet hours.
reviewReason: Expands basic apartment vocabulary into condominium management and community bylaws.
audioPurpose: Pronounce community housing administrative terms clearly.
successCriteria: Defines СӨХ (condominium association), нийтийн эзэмшил (common property), дуу чимээ (noise)
Expresses residential restrictions using -ж болохгүй accurately
masteryEvidence: Accurately categorizes 6 neighborhood activities into permitted vs prohibited times.

title: Tenant & Landlord: Negotiating Apartment Permissions & Renovation
primaryPurpose: Master spoken interaction between tenant and landlord: requesting permission to keep a pet, hang picture frames, repaint walls, or host overnight guests.
communicativeOutcome: Negotiate rental terms and obtain formal permission from a landlord for home modifications or pets.
listeningObjective: Understand landlord granting conditional permission: 'Ханан дээр жижиг зураг хадаж болно, харин хадаас том цоолж болохгүй'.
spokenProductionObjective: Request permission: 'Би байрандаа жижиг муур тэжээж болох уу? СӨХ-ийн дүрэмд зөвшөөрдөг юм байна лээ'.
pragmaticTarget: Securing explicit consent before altering leased property.
reviewReason: Elevates rental inquiries to nuanced permission negotiation.
audioPurpose: Deliver friendly, balanced dialogue between polite tenant and reasonable landlord.
successCriteria: Requests permission politely using '-ж болох уу?'
Understands and respects conditional provisos attached to permission grants
masteryEvidence: Conducts a 5-turn landlord-tenant dialogue negotiating pet ownership and wall mounting.

title: Deciphering Noise Curfew Bulletins & Waste Sorting Guidelines
primaryPurpose: Extract specific time windows (22:00 curfew) and recycling requirements from building notices.
communicativeOutcome: Heed verbal warnings from curators or security guards regarding flash photography, talking, or carrying open food containers.
listeningObjective: Identify specific prohibition ('Энд гэрэл асааж зураг авч болохгүй') from docent audio clips in a historical museum.
spokenProductionObjective: Warn a fellow tourist not to touch an exhibit: 'Үүнд хүрч болохгүй гэж байна'.
pragmaticTarget: Responding immediately and respectfully to institutional security reminders.
reviewReason: Sharpens auditory comprehension of public institutional announcements.
audioPurpose: Museum acoustics with quiet footsteps, echoing gallery, and firm, polite curator warnings.
successCriteria: Extracts specific prohibited behaviors accurately from audio stimuli
Distinguishes total bans from areas where flash-free photos are permitted
masteryEvidence: Correctly classifies 4 audio warning scenarios into permitted vs prohibited categories.

title: Community Rules: Drafting an Apartment Association (СӨХ) Bylaw Notice
primaryPurpose: Synthesize modal permission/prohibition forms (болно, болохгүй), civic living vocabulary, and temporal markers into an official apartment entryway notice.
communicativeOutcome: Draft a formal entryway notice for an apartment block informing residents of parking rules, quiet hours, and trash collection schedules.
readingObjective: Review authentic photographed entryway notices from Ulaanbaatar apartment complexes.
writingObjective: Draft a 5-point condominium notice using both болно and болохгүй accurately.
pragmaticTarget: Composing clear, authoritative, yet courteous community notices.
reviewReason: Advances written housing texts from descriptive to regulatory notices.
audioPurpose: Audio read-back of written community notice.
successCriteria: Produces written notice clearly distinguishing permitted times from prohibited behaviors
Correctly spells specialized terms: оршин суугчид, СӨХ, дуу чимээ, нийтийн эзэмшил
masteryEvidence: Drafts 'Оршин суугчдын анхааралд: Үдэш 22 цагаас хойш чанга дуу чимээ гаргаж болохгүй...' flawlessly.

title: I Can & I Struggle: Modal Ability with Чадах & Ядах
primaryPurpose: Introduce modal auxiliary verbs of capability and difficulty: converb in -ж/-ч + чадах (can / to be able) and -ж/-ч + ядах (to struggle to / fail to do).
communicativeOutcome: Express physical ability, learned skills, and bodily struggles (e.g. 'Би монголоор ярьж чадна', 'Өвдөөд босож ядаж байна').
readingObjective: Read occupational profiles listing physical abilities and language competencies.
listeningObjective: Identify modal auxiliaries (чадна vs ядаж байна) in conversational statements.
writingObjective: Write 4 sentences contrasting things you can do easily with physical tasks you struggle with.
